prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students have advanced knowledge regarding the essential and fundamental principles of electrical measurement technology as well as measurement procedures and systems.
Students are familiar with the function and application of important sensors and measuring devices as well as the associated basic circuits.

syllabus_topics: Measurement signals and measurement value processing
Measurement of DC and AC quantities
Measurement of non-electrical quantities (temperature, force, pressure, flow rate, rotational speed and velocity etc.)
Accompanying practical course to the lecture with special consideration of mechatronics
